name: Swastika Investmart Limited
about: Swastika Investmart Limited engages in the stock broking, depository participant, merchant banking, and other third-party products distribution activities in India. It operates through Broking and Related Services; and Merchant Banking & Investment Banking Services. The company provides stock broking across equity, commodity and currency segments; research services; investment advisory; portfolio management; corporate fixed deposits; bonds; non-convertible debentures; alternative investment funds; wealth bags; and other investment products. It also offers stock market research services; personal loans, loans against shares and securities, business loans, gold loans, and margin funding services; learning center; mutual funds; and investment banking services, including initial public offer listing, valuation, loan syndication, consultancy, equity funding, takeover/mergers and amalgamations services, merchant banking, and other services. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Indore, India.
